title: Remote Worker Connect
description: A local-to-remote product story that adds a worker, establishes a secure connection, and scales one active task.

source.name: iPolloWork HyperFrames
source.attribution: Original iPolloWork composition adapted from HyperFrames connection and interface-motion patterns.

applyChecklist: Replace the worker, region, task, and result with a truthful remote-work scenario.
Keep the local and remote surfaces distinct until the connection is visibly established.
Use design-system tokens for all themeable color, type, border, radius, and shadow values.
Verify the connection path and status labels remain readable at 30 fps.
